flow_summary: The system successfully completed the intake but struggled significantly with the patient's disorganized communication style. While it managed to extract the necessary information, it frequently failed to guide the patient effectively, leading to repetitive loops and frustration during the PHQ-9 and GAD-7 sections.

issues.evidence: In the GAD-7 section, the interviewer repeatedly asked the patient to choose from the list of options after the patient expressed confusion, rather than simplifying the prompt or acknowledging the patient's difficulty in a more supportive way.

The interviewer relied on rigid, repetitive prompts ('Please choose one response option') when the patient was clearly struggling to process the scale, which resulted in the patient providing vague answers like 'some weeks more than others' multiple times.
The transition to the PHQ-9 and GAD-7 sections felt mechanical and lacked the necessary flexibility to accommodate a patient who explicitly stated, 'My days all run together lately.'
